transcript: Speaker A: Mam, could you please give me a ride home? It's pretty late and I can't find a taxi or a bike anywhere. Speaker B: Yes, but lekin ek shart par. [Yes, but on one condition.] Speaker A: Kaisi shart? [What condition?] Speaker B: Yeh jo tum itni farratedar English bol rahe ho, mujhe bhi sikhoge? [This fluent English you are speaking, will you teach me too?] Speaker A: Nahi mam, main kya hi sikhunga aapko. Aap aisa kijiye, English Seekho app download kar lijiye. [No mam, what will I teach you. You do one thing, download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: English Seekho app? Yeh kya hai? [English Seekho app? What is this?] Speaker A: English Seekho app, English seekhne ka best app hai, jahan ekdam basic level se word to word jodkar sentence banane se lekar use advanced level ki farratedar English mein kaise bolna hai, sab kuch experts bahut hi aasan bhasha mein sikhate hain. Aur baat rahi kisi ke saath practice karne ki, toh English Seekho app ka AI coach aapke saath baat karne ke liye 24/7 available rehta hai. Aur is coach ki sabse khaas baat yeh hai ki yeh kabhi aapki galat English ka mazak nahi udayega, balki aapki galtiyon ko acche se samjha kar aapko correct karega. [English Seekho app is the best app to learn English, where experts teach everything in very simple language, from basic level word-to-word sentence building to speaking fluent English at an advanced level. And as for practicing with someone, English Seekho app's AI coach is available 24/7 to talk to you. And the best part about this coach is that it will never make fun of your wrong English, but will explain your mistakes well and correct you.] Speaker B: Are wah! Phir toh main abhi download karti hoon English Seekho app. [Oh wow! Then I will download the English Seekho app right now.] Speaker A: Haan haan, kar lijiye download English Seekho app aur mujhe mere ghar chhod dijiye. [Yes yes, download the English Seekho app and drop me home.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A stranded young man asks a woman on a scooter for a ride, and she agrees on the condition that he teaches her fluent English. He recommends the 'English Seekho' app, explaining its step-by-step lessons and supportive 24/7 AI coach. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
